details.problem: The existing backend on AWS Amplify V1 was hindered by versioning conflicts and inefficient resource usage, leading to high operational costs and limitations in functionality.
details.solution: I led a critical system migration to AWS Amplify V2, where I designed and implemented a new set of scalable GraphQL APIs using TypeScript and DynamoDB. This resolved the versioning issues and modernized the backend architecture for better cost-efficiency and performance.
